Method of Attack: Weaponized Microsoft Office documents with malicious macros or exploits
Excel 4.0 XML macros to download and execute payloads using regsvr32 or rundll32
Bypassing Windows Defender, Windows AMSI, and email service protections
Impacted Systems: Windows systems targeted by Trickbot, BazarLoader/BazarBackdoor, IcedID/BokBot, Ursnif/Gozi ISFB, QakBot/QBot malware
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Office documents delivered via spam campaigns
Macros and exploits embedded in documents
Social engineering to enable macros posing as DocuSign or DigiCert documents
